selection_rule: Retain only input profiles and corresponding structure prefixes: single, one_round
split_policy: Preserve original v7 FIT/DEV/TEST; no resplitting or source reassignment
standardizer: Recompute family-weighted mean/std on selected-profile FIT only
training: Randomly initialize all seven original linear/MLP candidates; select only on selected-profile DEV
agentdojo: Post-freeze readout on sealed no-injection 57-task first-position normal-body masks
head_discovery_limitation: Reuse the original ordered 16 v7 heads, discovered using mixed pilot FIT. Only the probe weights and FIT standardizer are retrained using the declared filtered article profiles. No historical probe weights or standardizer are inherited.
